message:
We had a little incident last weekend that reminded us why we put so much effort into our home readiness plans. Our neighbor called in a bit of a panic—she’d forgotten to prepare for a minor storm, and her family was scrambling to find flashlights and snacks. 

We couldn’t help but feel a tad smug when we invited them over for some hot cocoa and to share our go-bag stash. It was a light-hearted moment, but it really drove home the importance of being ready. 

Sometimes, it’s the simple things, like having a few essentials packed and a plan in place, that make all the difference. 🤗 What’s one tip or trick you’ve found helpful for being prepared at home?
